switch.surface: native checkbox with role=switch in the Ready bottom status row
switch.label: short locale-owned External sources equivalent
switch.explicit_change: same-origin POST updates server state; toggle alone never contacts an external provider

tab_and_locale_state.browser_storage: sessionStorage under the existing versioned exact-locale floating-assistant key
tab_and_locale_state.server_key: HttpOnly assistant session plus opaque tab ID plus exact locale

transport.status: GET /api/documentation-assistant/web-mode with locale and opaque tab_id after explicit assistant opening
transport.chat: chat includes opaque tab_id and presentation web_mode, while the server derives effective authority from its stored mode

external_answer.schema: optional bounded external_claims beside unchanged local text and local citations
external_answer.region: separately labelled locale-owned External sources region below the local answer and local sources
external_answer.source: server-resolved opaque handle with exact external_untrusted kind and Brave provider ID
external_answer.url: HTTPS URL must pass the same Mozilla host/path allowlist in the browser before becoming a link
external_answer.link: new browsing context with noopener noreferrer
external_answer.persistence: external claims and URLs are not placed in browser storage
